plan.summary: One thing called a project. It picks whole repositories or folders of a monorepo, and holds its own pull request mode, auto merge, autonomy, tracker, review settings, Operator rules and look, each set key by key over Kit. Today's Workspaces and task-list Projects both become projects, and their tasks stay. A Job keeps the project it was started from and runs on its values, and Fleet says which layer each value came from. A project is kept on this Mac, a synced folder, cloud storage or a repository, whichever you pick. The native switcher reads all of it from Fleet.

groups.title: Projects replace Workspaces

tasks.text: Rename the multi-repository Workspace to Project in core-model and config; a member is a repository with an optional folder
Allow a project with no members yet, so a new one can be made before it holds anything

Mirror the wire in packages/protocol and point Electron's Workspace reader at list_projects, the smallest change

groups.title: Project values with their layers

tasks.text: One resolver for behaviour keys: default, Machine, Kit, repository, Project, Job, each value with the layer it came from
Project values for pull request mode, auto merge, autonomy defaults, review model, Job layout, theme and density
A Job freezes its project's resolved values at start and runs on them
A project's tracker replaces its members' trackers for Jobs in it and for the project's issues
Serve each value with its layer for Settings, document the chain and close kit-machine-manifest-resolution-chain

groups.title: Reviews and Operator rules per project
groups.gives: The four review lists filter to a project's members, and Always here keeps a rule for the project

Move existing Always here rules across as repository-scoped
